claims.text: EPT = an alternate approach if a partner can't access timely care.
claims.quote: EPT could be an alternate approach if a partner is unable to access timely care

claims.text: Chlamydia: routinely offer EPT if you can't ensure all partners from the prior 60 days will seek timely tx.
claims.quote: medical providers should routinely offer EPT to patients with chlamydia when the provider cannot ensure that all of a patient’s sex partners from the previous 60 days will seek timely treatment
